assertions: Every measured request agrees with the complete census on Recommended surface, exact matching count and first-six allocation states, and with Stage 9 on structural/PASS/UNCERTAIN/REJECT counts.
userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/152.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

conditions.workers: New worker for each root request; normal HTTP cache warmed by setup; no forced CPU throttle.
conditions.app: Next production server; root/quality/context selection uses rendered DOM controls only.
conditions.instrumentation: A JSON serialization and UTF-8 byte-count listener runs before normal client decoding; reported end-to-end values include this measurement overhead.
conditions.renderEndpoint: Exact current response committed with fresh selected snapshot and enabled Play button, followed by one paint frame.
conditions.ancillaryCoverage: Census-widest root of every quality/context; 40 requests if all qualities run.
conditions.heap: Main page Runtime.getHeapUsage after explicit GC, initial warmup and each 100 measured root changes; total page heap, not engine-only attribution.

observedMainThreadLongTasks.attribution: Observed during measured request/page/filter/selection windows; engine attribution requires a trace.

limits: Desktop Chromium only; Firefox/WebKit and representative physical mobile gates need separate evidence.
Card selection uses an already materialized page row; it is not a direct-lookup benchmark.
Enabled Play confirms an exact audio snapshot is available; sample output onset is not timed.
Explicit GC measurements cover the main page heap, not combined worker/renderer process memory.
Performance evidence does not establish human preference, playability or comfort.
